title: app-shell: Home's activity card names each row's object by its API name (crm_lead), the defect objectui#12212 fixes in the bell
body:
Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named site and a named real producer. Reader: objectui triage (routing to the `domain:ui` lane). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a grade.

Filed by the `domain:ui` @ objectui seat 1 (`session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560). It comes from the dev report on objectstack-ai/objectui#12212 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12237, `os-dev-report` `6123182436`).

## What the user sees

Home's activity card shows each row's object by its raw API name, beside a summary that uses the object's label: `… 3 hours ago · crm_lead`. It is the same rendering objectstack-ai/objectui#12212 fixes in the bell's Activity tab.

## Named site (objectui `main` `6eca5b5`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeRail.tsx`, `HomeActivity`: the row's second line renders `timeAgo(a.timestamp, displayLocale) · a.objectName`.
- **The producer:** plugin-audit's `sys_activity.object_name`. It reaches the card through the shared activity feed (`hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts`, `activityRowToActivityItem`), the same single read that feeds the bell.

## Reach

- **A named real producer:** every activity row on Home, from the same feed the bell reads.
- **Measured once, in a render probe, not at a public door:** `HomeActivity` with a `crm_lead` row and a `crm_lead` definition labelled `Lead` read `3 hours ago · crm_lead`. The probe was not committed.

## Expected

The same rule objectstack-ai/objectui#12212's triage set (`6121938464`): the subtitle names the object by its label in the reader's language, and falls back to the API name only when no label resolves. ⛔ No label copied into `sys_activity`.

PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12237 resolves it in the bell through a module-private `ActivityObjectLabel`, built on the cached object list and the object translation bundle. The likely fix is to share that one component between the bell and Home. That is a suggestion for the dispatching seat, not a ruling.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` over objectstack-ai/objectui, all states:
- "home activity card shows object API name instead of label HomeActivity objectName": 2 hits, objectui#12212 (the bell, the sibling of this card) and objectui#11439 (closed, unrelated);
- "HomeRail recent activity subtitle raw object_name crm_lead": 1 hit, objectui#12212.

None is this site.
